NONE: B2 used to describe something that exists but is not very good
名不符實的；所謂的

example: The school had a swimming pool of a kind, but it was too small for most classes to use.
學校有一個所謂的泳池，但對大多數班級來說都太小了，不夠用。

NONE: › used to show that you are especially surprised at a particular person's behaviour because it does not seem typical of them
在所有的人當中偏偏（或唯有）

example: I thought that you, of all people, would believe me!
我本來以為在所有人當中起碼你會相信我！

NONE: › used to express the idea that a particular person/thing/place is unlikely or surprising
（表示認為不可能或驚訝）在所有的人／東西／地方中（偏偏）

example: Donna, of all people, is the last one I'd expect to see at the gym.
我萬萬沒有想到會在健身房裡見到當娜。
And why did you choose Iceland for a holiday, of all places?
那麼多的地方，你為甚麼偏偏要去冰島度假？

NONE: › Your thing or person of choice is the one that you usually choose in a particular situation.
藥物

example: Botox is now the drug of choice in Hollywood.
肉毒注射目前是好萊塢的首選藥物。

NONE: A1 informal used to say yes or to give someone permission to do something
（表示肯定或允許）當然
B1 used to show that what you are saying is obvious or already known
（用於表示所說的很顯然或已經爲人所知）當然
› used to show that a situation or a piece of information is not surprising
（用於表示某一情況或資訊不足為怪）當然，自然

example: "Can you help me?" "Of course."
「你能幫幫我嗎？」「當然可以。」
"May I look at your newspaper?" "Of course you can."
「我能看看你的報紙嗎？」「當然可以。」
"Have you written your English essay yet?" "Of course, I finished it last week."
「你的英語論文寫了嗎？」「當然了，我上週就寫完了。」
We arrived at the restaurant 30 minutes late so, of course, our reservation had been cancelled.
我們到餐廳晚了30分鐘，所以，預訂自然就被取消了。

NONE: A2 used to emphasize that you disagree or that something is not true
（用於強調不同意或不正確）當然不

example: "Where did you get the money? Did you steal it?" "Of course not. I borrowed it from Carol."
「你哪裡來的錢？是偷的嗎？」「當然不是，我向卡羅爾借的。」

NONE: › of all types
各類

example: Governments of every stripe (= of all political opinions) have a bad habit of interfering in state broadcasting.
持各種政治主張的政府都有干涉公營廣播電台的壞習慣。

NONE: › recently
最近，近來

example: We haven't spoken of late.
我們最近沒有說過話。

NONE: › literary in or from the past
在過去；從前
› mainly UK for a very long time
很長時間

example: in days of old
從前
I know him of old.
我認識他很久了。

NONE: › used to describe something that is not a typical or good example of something
勉強稱得上的，湊合的

example: He managed to make a curtain of sorts out of an old sheet.
他用一條舊床單湊合做了個窗簾。

NONE: › like or similar to what has been said
（與說過的話）類似的

example: "You said I was fat." "I didn't say anything of the kind!"
「你說我胖。」「我沒說過那種話！」

NONE: › the person or thing that is the most important and successful at a particular time
（在某一時刻）最重要的；最成功的

example: Jack was man of the moment during the crisis.
傑克是這場危機中的關鍵人物。

NONE: › traditional and old-fashioned
老派的；守舊的
› A thing or person of the week is one that has been chosen as the best in a particular week
本周最佳；本周特薦

example: Book of the Week: Dog Breeds by Andrew and Helen Barker.
本周特薦書：《狗的品種》，安德魯·巴克和海倫·巴克著。

NONE: › A thing or person of the year is one that has been chosen as the best in a particular year, especially in a competition.
（尤指競賽中）年度最佳…

example: Young Musician of the Year
本年度最傑出的青年音樂家

NONE: › your own fault
（某人）自找的，（某人）自作自受的

example: Any problems she has with that child are of her own making.
她和那個孩子之間的問題都是她自己造成的。
